title: Margin of Safety
coreMove: Add enough buffer that normal variance cannot turn a good decision into a fragile one.
sourcePressure: Action needs protection against uncertainty: slack, buffer, resilience, and practical protection against ordinary error and variance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating margin as pessimism, waste, or financial formula instead of practical resilience.
